dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this one's kinda nostalgic too.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It's here because I refused to let that mage use my house as her playground.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: But, we still needed an additional rest area for the guests, so we set up this tent instead.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Looks like we can use this device to keep in touch with the mages or get some hints... Kinda like we were able to do back then, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, the arrangement is almost identical.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Knights on vacation, summer, the sea, and a small little Waverider. Hehe, it's all taking me back.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: However, you're forgetting about the part where we were stranded on a deserted island and couldn't even make it across the water. That's what stuck with me the most.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, I remember. At least I wasn't dead weight in that situation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, fun times, huh... So, the mages prepared this stuff, then? Guess we should take a picture and go check in with them.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You know, the expedition in Nod-Krai is coming to an end, but knowing Grand Master Varka... I imagine there will be another chance to set off in the near future.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ahem, not that I'm extending an invitation. I'm just... mentioning the possibility, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's our Honorary Knight! No matter the mission, you always have a place among our ranks.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Come talk to me when you do have an official invitation, then. I have other things to do in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: The intel I have on hand is pulling me in a hundred different directions, but unfortunately, "time off" isn't one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: That's a shame. I take vacation whenever I can get it, and it's still never enough. I'd visit the Golden Apple Archipelago again in a heartbeat...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: For once... I feel the same.
